verdict.rationale: Perplexity has official app-store listings on both iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). The iOS listing documents a broad feature set: Pro Search and Deep Research, Labs, Assistant, Voice, cited sources, Library, Discover and thread follow-ups. The Android listing notes cross-device sync. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile app quality, and an Android-specific feature breakdown showing parity with iOS.
